title: Out of memory retry text
text: T-4396 (landed 3add0b644) adds two notices: "This game ran out of memory, so it loaded again without intercity trips." and "This game ran out of memory, so it loaded again in less detail." Text acknowledged, or name a line?

title: Server deploy, crash counts
text: Deploy shonei-server with 54c6241 (T-4409 crash counts, twstats Failures table) and ff4e198 (save check at level 42, which the next publish needs because T-4380 raised the save level)? Recommended: yes, now.

title: Edit design: A1 lie
text: T-4267 stage A1: a quick run of clicks on running track has its trains worked out as one edit, so a line sharing that track can end with a train more or fewer than the same clicks made slowly. OK? Recommended: yes (changes the 2026-11-25 T-4272 DECISIONS entry).

title: Edit design: drop holds
text: T-4267 stage B9: take out the stop-click hold (500 ms) and the track-run hold (220 ms) once each follow-up costs only the edit? Recommended: yes.

title: Edit design: C7 only if
text: T-4267 stage C7 (far lines on shared track settle up to about a second later): build it only if measuring after C1-C6 calls for it? Recommended: yes.
